changeSet.author: credesal
changeSet.comment: Register the USD-only Credesal Balance de Comprobacion report for every upgraded tenant. The report uses the frozen Arissto COA presentation metadata installed by migration 0337.
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO stretchy_report ( report_name, report_type, report_subtype, report_category, report_sql, description, core_report, use_report, self_service_user_report ) VALUES ( 'Balance de Comprobación', 'Table', NULL, 'Accounting', $report$ WITH RECURSIVE presentation_integrity AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) = 2482 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE trial_balance_selected) = 101 AND COUNT(DISTINCT presentation_version) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT source_snapshot_sha256) = 1 AND MIN(presentation_version) = 'arissto-coa-presentation-v1' AND MIN(source_snapshot_sha256) = '9e4d2a035daf0d21944ef21684a467d26349023e2b2c56e30ffc98385bc56282' AS valid FROM credesal_gl_account_presentation ), selected_offices AS ( SELECT office_under.id, office_under.external_id FROM m_office selected_office JOIN m_office office_under ON office_under.hierarchy LIKE selected_office.hierarchy || '%' WHERE selected_office.id = CAST('${officeId}' AS BIGINT) AND office_under.hierarchy LIKE '${currentUserHierarchy}' || '%' AND office_under.external_id IS NOT NULL ), selected_accounts AS ( SELECT presentation.gl_account_id AS report_account_id, presentation.source_gl_code, presentation.source_name, presentation.classifier_code, presentation.classifier_name, presentation.trial_balance_group, presentation.trial_balance_order, presentation.balance_nature, parent.id AS group_account_id, parent.gl_code AS group_code, COALESCE(parent_presentation.source_name, parent.name) AS group_name FROM credesal_gl_account_presentation presentation JOIN acc_gl_account account ON account.id = presentation.gl_account_id JOIN acc_gl_account parent ON parent.id = account.parent_id LEFT JOIN credesal_gl_account_presentation parent_presentation ON parent_presentation.gl_account_id = parent.id CROSS JOIN presentation_integrity integrity WHERE presentation.trial_balance_selected AND integrity.valid ), report_tree AS ( SELECT selected.report_account_id, selected.source_gl_code, selected.source_name, selected.classifier_code, selected.classifier_name, selected.trial_balance_group, selected.trial_balance_order, selected.balance_nature, selected.group_account_id, selected.group_code, selected.group_name, selected.report_account_id AS descendant_account_id, ARRAY[selected.report_account_id]::BIGINT[] AS account_path FROM selected_accounts selected
UNION ALL
SELECT tree.report_account_id, tree.source_gl_code, tree.source_name, tree.classifier_code, tree.classifier_name, tree.trial_balance_group, tree.trial_balance_order, tree.balance_nature, tree.group_account_id, tree.group_code, tree.group_name, child.id, tree.account_path || child.id FROM report_tree tree JOIN acc_gl_account child ON child.parent_id = tree.descendant_account_id WHERE NOT child.id = ANY(tree.account_path) ), component_balances AS ( SELECT tree.report_account_id, tree.source_gl_code, tree.source_name, tree.classifier_code, tree.classifier_name, tree.trial_balance_group, tree.trial_balance_order, tree.group_account_id, tree.group_code, tree.group_name, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN tree.balance_nature = 'D' THEN CASE WHEN journal_entry.type_enum = 2 THEN journal_entry.amount ELSE -journal_entry.amount END ELSE CASE WHEN journal_entry.type_enum = 1 THEN journal_entry.amount ELSE -journal_entry.amount END END ), 0.00 ), 2 ) AS balance FROM report_tree tree LEFT JOIN acc_gl_journal_entry journal_entry ON journal_entry.account_id = tree.descendant_account_id AND journal_entry.entry_date <= CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) AND journal_entry.currency_code = 'USD' AND jsonb_typeof(journal_entry.dimensions -> 'office') = 'string' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM selected_offices office WHERE office.id = journal_entry.office_id AND office.external_id = journal_entry.dimensions ->> 'office' ) GROUP BY tree.report_account_id, tree.source_gl_code, tree.source_name, tree.classifier_code, tree.classifier_name, tree.trial_balance_group, tree.trial_balance_order, tree.group_account_id, tree.group_code, tree.group_name ), visible_components AS ( SELECT * FROM component_balances WHERE balance <> 0.00 ), visible_groups AS ( SELECT classifier_code, classifier_name, trial_balance_group, trial_balance_order, group_account_id, group_code, group_name, SUM(balance) AS balance FROM visible_components GROUP BY classifier_code, classifier_name, trial_balance_group, trial_balance_order, group_account_id, group_code, group_name ), section_totals AS ( SELECT classifier_code, MIN(classifier_name) AS classifier_name, MIN(trial_balance_group) AS trial_balance_group, MIN(trial_balance_order) AS trial_balance_order, SUM(balance) AS balance FROM visible_components GROUP BY classifier_code ), side_totals AS ( SELECT trial_balance_group, SUM(balance) AS balance FROM visible_components GROUP BY trial_balance_group ), display_rows AS ( SELECT section.trial_balance_order AS section_order, 0 AS row_order, ''::VARCHAR AS group_code, ''::VARCHAR AS component_code, 'SECCION'::VARCHAR AS row_type, section.classifier_name AS section_name, NULL::VARCHAR AS group_name, NULL::VARCHAR AS account_code, section.classifier_name AS description, NULL::NUMERIC AS balance FROM section_totals section
UNION ALL
SELECT report_group.trial_balance_order, 1, report_group.group_code, '', 'GRUPO', report_group.classifier_name, report_group.group_name, report_group.group_code, report_group.group_name, report_group.balance FROM visible_groups report_group
UNION ALL
SELECT component.trial_balance_order, 2, component.group_code, component.source_gl_code, 'CUENTA', component.classifier_name, component.group_name, component.source_gl_code, component.source_name, component.balance FROM visible_components component
UNION ALL
SELECT section.trial_balance_order, 3, '~~~~', '', 'TOTAL_SECCION', section.classifier_name, NULL, NULL, CASE section.classifier_code WHEN '001' THEN 'TOTAL ACTIVO' WHEN '002' THEN 'TOTAL PASIVO' END, section.balance FROM section_totals section WHERE section.classifier_code IN ('001', '002')
UNION ALL
SELECT 5, 4, '~~~~', '', 'TOTAL_INTERMEDIO', 'CAPITAL', NULL, NULL, 'TOTAL PASIVO, PATRIMONIO Y RESERVAS', SUM(balance) FILTER (WHERE classifier_code IN ('002', '003')) FROM section_totals
UNION ALL
SELECT CASE side.trial_balance_group WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 7 END, 9, '~~~~', '', 'TOTAL_BALANCE', NULL, NULL, NULL, CASE side.trial_balance_group WHEN 1 THEN 'TOTAL DE ACTIVO Y CUENTAS DEUDORAS' ELSE 'TOTALES' END, side.balance FROM side_totals side ), ordered_rows AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY section_order, CASE WHEN row_order IN (0, 3, 4, 9) THEN row_order ELSE 1 END, group_code COLLATE "C", row_order, component_code COLLATE "C" ) AS display_order, row_type, section_name, group_name, account_code, description, balance FROM display_rows ) SELECT display_order AS "Orden", row_type AS "Tipo Fila", section_name AS "Sección", group_name AS "Grupo", account_code AS "Cuenta", description AS "Descripción", balance AS "Saldo" FROM ordered_rows ORDER BY display_order $report$, 'Balance de comprobación agrupado al corte, en USD y filtrado por oficina.', FALSE, TRUE, FALSE ) ON CONFLICT (report_name) DO UPDATE SET report_type = EXCLUDED.report_type, report_subtype = EXCLUDED.report_subtype, report_category = EXCLUDED.report_category, report_sql = EXCLUDED.report_sql, description = EXCLUDED.description, core_report = EXCLUDED.core_report, use_report = EXCLUDED.use_report, self_service_user_report = EXCLUDED.self_service_user_report;
DELETE FROM stretchy_report_parameter WHERE report_id = ( SELECT id FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Balance de Comprobación' );
INSERT INTO stretchy_report_parameter ( report_id, parameter_id, report_parameter_name ) SELECT report.id, parameter.id, parameter.parameter_variable FROM stretchy_report report JOIN stretchy_parameter parameter ON parameter.parameter_name IN ('OfficeIdSelectOne', 'endDateSelect') WHERE report.report_name = 'Balance de Comprobación';
DO $validation$ BEGIN IF ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report_parameter usage JOIN stretchy_report report ON report.id = usage.report_id WHERE report.report_name = 'Balance de Comprobación' AND usage.report_parameter_name IN ('officeId', 'endDate') ) <> 2 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Balance de Comprobación requires officeId and endDate parameters'; END IF; END $validation$;
INSERT INTO m_permission ( grouping, code, entity_name, action_name, can_maker_checker ) SELECT 'report', 'READ_Balance de Comprobación', 'Balance de Comprobación', 'READ', FALSE WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_permission WHERE code = 'READ_Balance de Comprobación' );
